sources.entry: PlayCover - Run iOS apps and games on Apple Silicon Macs with mouse, keyboard and controller support. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/PlayCover/PlayCover)

summary.one_liner: PlayCover is a macOS app that runs iOS apps and games on Apple Silicon Macs, with support for mouse, keyboard and controller input.
summary.what_it_does: PlayCover wraps iOS apps so they run on Apple Silicon Macs by imitating an iPad environment. It lets users map custom touch controls to keyboard keys, including WASD, camera movement, left and right clicks, and per-key bindings. The project was originally built to run Genshin Impact and can now run a range of other apps. The README notes that not all games are supported and some may have bugs. It can be installed from a stable release download or built from source, with setup details in the external documentation. A Homebrew cask is also provided.
use_cases: run iOS games on a Mac
play mobile games with keyboard and mouse
run Genshin Impact on Apple Silicon Mac
remap touch controls to keyboard keys
install iPhone apps on M1 or M2 Mac
notable: Runs iOS apps through a wrapper that imitates an iPad, so apps run natively
Keyboard mapping for touch controls, including WASD and camera movement, similar to Bluestacks-style keymapping
Distributed as a Homebrew cask via a tap
caveats: Only works on Apple Silicon Macs (M-series chips); Intel Macs are not supported
Not all games are supported and some may have bugs
